title: Downloading Audit Logs and Event Logs Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information on how to generate and download audit log and event log reports as CSV files using the API.

Audit logs record all admin activities in the Zscaler Admin Console for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and the actions performed using the API. You can download admin audit log reports for up to 31 days or a maximum of 1,000 records at a time. Admin audit logs are stored for the last 6 months. To learn more, see About Audit Logs.
The following steps explain how to generate and download an admin audit log report using the API:

blocks.item: 1. Generate the report.
Initiate the audit log report generation by sending a POST request to /auditlogEntryReport with the date range specified in the request Body:
startTime: The start time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation.
endTime: The end time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation.
For example, in Python:
The request Body can include additional parameters to filter specific records based on predefined criteria. You can also paginate the results. To learn more, see the API Reference.
This POST request returns a status ID for the report being created along with other information.
Sample response:
{ "status" : "EXECUTING", "statusId" : "eaab786c44674a96be790625f527b0e9", "reportType" : "ZMANAGE_AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_REPORT", }

From the POST /auditlogEntryReport response, capture the statusId value (e.g., "eaab786c44674a96be790625f527b0e9"). The statusId is required in subsequent requests to poll for the report status and then to download the report.
2. Poll for report status.

After initiating the report generation, poll for the report status by making repeated requests to GET /auditlogEntryReport and appending the statusId query parameter received from the POST response (i.e., GET /auditlogEntryReport?statusId=eaab786c44674a96be790625f527b0e9).
Sample response:
{ "status" : "EXECUTING", "progressItemsComplete" : 0, "progressEndTime" : 0, "percentage" : 0 }
Continue polling until the report reaches a terminal status, such as COMPLETE, CANCELLED, ERRORED, or STOP.
Sample response:
{ "status" : "COMPLETE", "progressItemsComplete" : 0, "progressEndTime" : 0, "percentage" : 0 }
3. Download the report.

When the status is COMPLETE, you can download the report as a CSV file by sending a GET request to /auditlogEntryReport/download and appending the statusId query parameter received from the POST response (i.e., GET /auditlogEntryReport/download?statusId=eaab786c44674a96be790625f527b0e9). A successful response returns a 200 OK status code with the log data available in the report.
Sample response:

Administrator,admin@acme.com Report Created,"26 Mar 2026 04:07:28, PDT" Start Time,"25 Mar 2026 11:30:00, PDT" End Time,"26 Mar 2026 04:02:38, PDT" Time,User,Action,AA in Cloud,Result,Client IP,Interface,Category,Subcategory,Resource,Pre Action,After,TraceId "26 Mar 2026 00:30:19, PDT",admin@acme.com,Sign In,zscalerbeta.net,Successful,192.0.2.1,API,Login,Login,,,,, "26 Mar 2026 00:23:42, PDT",admin@acme.com,Sign In,zscalerbeta.net,Successful,192.0.2.2,UI,Login,Login,,,,, ...

The response is formatted according to the time zone configured in the Zscaler Admin Console under Account Settings icon > Account Settings in the top navigation bar. To learn more, see Customizing Your Account Settings.
You can download only the latest report generated at any time. Making a POST /auditlogEntryReport request overwrites any previously generated report.
To cancel a report generation request, send a DELETE request to /auditlogEntryReport with the statusId query parameter retrieved from the POST response.
